restaurantName: Shan Li Yan Sha Cha Mian
address: 285 Datong Road, Siming, Xiamen, China Mainland
bio: At this friendly neighbourhood shop in the old town, the owner couple knows every customer by name. Sha cha noodles are their speciality: whatever the time of the day, the rich broth is always piping hot, striking a balance between garlic, peanut and chilli flavours. In addition to year-round favourite toppings – from fish balls and pork liver to pork tendon – umami-laden seasonal shellfish such as oysters and razor clams are also a must!...
pageTitle: Shan Li Yan Sha Cha Mian
